system.description:
Two heads in permanent conflict. Madness, the deep ocean, and the terror at the bottom of the dark.

  • Dark Gift (1st): Once per day, one creature within 60ft that can see you makes a Will save against your Class Save DC or is frightened for 1 round. On a natural 1 they are stunned instead.
  • Patron's Mark (4th): Once per day, hold eye contact with one creature within 30ft for 1 round — they make a Will save or become briefly confused, spending their next action doing something erratic and harmless determined by the GM.
  • Patron Feature (8th): Once per day, all creatures within 30ft make a Will save or suffer one of: attack the nearest creature, drop held items and flee, or stand transfixed and lose their next action.

Allegiance: Chaotic Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Demogorgon in the World of Arneyan wiki.
